title: RFAs: Ending Impunity for International Crimes in Ukraine
desc: Deadline: 08-May-2026 The International Renaissance Foundation grant competition supports civil society organizations working to investigate and prosecute international crimes in Ukraine. It funds projects that strengthen justice systems, support victims, and improve evidence collection for war crimes and human rights violations. Grants range from 1,000,000 to 4,000,000 UAH for projects lasting up to 12 months.
